system.notes: After 24 hours at sea out of sight of land: Willpower (4) Test needing 2 successes, or the character slowly goes mad — fearing being thrown overboard, sabotaging, even attacking companions to reach land. Repeat every Intelligence hours (+1 TN after a success, +2 after a failure). Passes in hours equal to the failures once land is seen; past 24 failures, days.
